proposals.name: ratewise
proposals.tagline: Human-readable transfer rates, ETAs and data budgets: '3 GB at 25 MB/s' → '2m'.
proposals.concept: A tiny library and CLI for anyone who moves data: parse sizes ('1.5 GB') and rates ('100 Mbit/s', '20 GB/day'), format rates back for humans, estimate how long a transfer takes, and compute how much data fits in a time window. Useful for download managers, backup scripts, CI logs and capacity planning.
proposals.newCapability: Rates: sizes divided by durations. Neither donor can parse '20 GB/day', convert it to bytes per second, or answer 'how long will 3 GB take at 25 MB/s?'.
proposals.whyItIsNew: ms knows time but not data; pretty-bytes knows data but not time and cannot parse. Fused, they describe throughput: a separate domain neither covers.

api.name: parseSize
api.description: Parses '1.5 GB', '2 KiB', '100 Mbit' or a bare number of bytes into bytes. Bits are divided by 8. Returns NaN for unrecognised text.

api.name: parseRate
api.description: Parses '<size>/<duration unit>' such as '5 MB/s', '20 GB/day', '100 Mbit/s' into bytes per second. Returns NaN for unrecognised text.

api.name: formatSize
api.signature: formatSize(bytes: number, options?: { binary?: boolean, bits?: boolean }): string
api.description: Formats bytes with 3 significant digits, e.g. 1337 → '1.34 kB'.

api.name: formatRate
api.signature: formatRate(bytesPerSecond: number, options?: { per?: 's'|'m'|'h'|'d', binary?: boolean, bits?: boolean }): string
api.description: Formats a rate, e.g. 1337 → '1.34 kB/s'; with bits, 12500000 → '100 Mbit/s'.

api.name: eta
api.signature: eta(size: number|string, rate: number|string, options?: { long?: boolean }): string
api.description: How long a transfer takes, as a short ('2m') or long ('2 minutes') duration.

api.name: budget
api.description: Bytes transferred at a rate over a duration (milliseconds or text like '1h').

proposals.name: staleness
proposals.tagline: Cache size and age policies in one readable string: 'max 500 MB, evict after 7d'.
proposals.concept: A policy parser and checker for caches: express limits as human strings and ask whether an entry or a cache directory violates them, with readable explanations.
proposals.newCapability: Combined size-and-age policies with human-readable violation messages.
proposals.whyItIsNew: Neither donor models limits or policies; together they express both dimensions of cache eviction.

api.name: parsePolicy
api.signature: parsePolicy(text: string): { maxBytes: number, maxAgeMs: number }

api.name: check
api.signature: check(policy, entry: { bytes: number, ageMs: number }): { ok: boolean, reasons: string[] }
api.description: Checks an entry against a policy.

proposals.name: quotaclock
proposals.tagline: Readable usage quotas: '10 GB per 30d' with remaining-allowance messages.
proposals.concept: Model data quotas over time windows (mobile plans, API egress limits) and report usage and remaining allowance for humans.
proposals.newCapability: Quota windows that combine a data allowance with a time period.
proposals.whyItIsNew: Quotas need both a size and a period, which neither donor expresses alone.

api.name: parseQuota
api.signature: parseQuota(text: string): { bytes: number, windowMs: number }
